figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: one experiment plus one equation En = -13.6 Z²/n² plus one spectral rule
figures.read: every result is the scattering geometry, the level energy En, or the transition difference Ei - Ef

figures.title: Thomson versus Rutherford: same beam, two predictions
figures.why: the same alpha beam must come out nearly straight or occasionally back-scattered; the difference is the test
figures.data: Thomson pudding → 1° deflections; Rutherford nucleus → rare large-angle Coulomb scattering
figures.read: rare large-angle scattering is the smoking gun for a concentrated charge

figures.title: Photon vs electron: who may pay
figures.why: all-or-nothing photon versus part-paying electron is the sharpest conceptual test
figures.data: photon needs exactly Em - En; electron may hand over any part of its kinetic energy
figures.read: the light quantum is all-or-nothing; the electron can pay in instalments
figures.source: §3.7 Transitions, excitation, and who may pay

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: scattering words to Rutherford, wavelength words to the ladder, and photon/electron excite differently

figures.title: Energy levels: the En ladder
figures.why: the whole spectrum is differences between rungs of one ladder
figures.read: rungs crowd toward zero as 1/n²; a photon is the energy difference between rungs

figures.title: The Balmer series: lines crowd toward a limit
figures.why: the tightening spacing is the 1/n² ladder in wavelength space
figures.read: the first line is longest and most separated; higher lines bunch toward the limit
